crossRefs.note: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,
in addition to that which the traders brought, and the traffic of the merchants, and of all the kings of the mixed…
Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless…
